28399-four-plays-of-gil-vicente.title: Four Plays Of Gil Vicente
28399-four-plays-of-gil-vicente.creator: Unknown
28399-four-plays-of-gil-vicente.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Those who read the voluminous song-book edited by jolly Garcia de Resende in 1516 are astonished at its narrowness and aridity. There is scarcely a breath of poetry or of Nature in these Court verses. In the pages of Gil Vicente[6], who had begun to write fourteen years before the _Cancioneiro Geral_ was published, the Court is still present, yet the atmosphere is totally different.

arxiv-2304-02524.title: Picturing Counting Reductions with the ZH-Calculus
arxiv-2304-02524.creator: Tuomas Laakkonen 1,a, Konstantinos Meichanetzidis 1,b, John van de Wetering 2,c
arxiv-2304-02524.description: Abstract Counting the solutions to Boolean formulae defines the problem #SAT , which is complete for the complexity class #P . We use the ZH-calculus, a universal and complete graphical language for linear maps which naturally encodes counting problems in terms of diagrams, to give graphical reductions from #SAT to several related counting problems.

arxiv-2404-05171.title: A Monte-Carlo Simulation on Resonant Scattering of X-ray Line Emission in Supernova Remnants
arxiv-2404-05171.creator: Yiping Li, Gao-Yuan Zhang, Yang Chen, Lei Sun, Shuinai Zhang
arxiv-2404-05171.description: Abstract Resonant scattering (RS) of X-ray line emission in supernova remnants (SNRs) may modify the observed line profiles and fluxes and has potential impact on estimating the physical properties of the hot gas and hence on understanding the SNR physics, but has not been theoretically modeled ever.

arxiv-2412-05220.title: Millisecond Pulsars in Globular Clusters and Implications for the Galactic Center Gamma-Ray Excess
arxiv-2412-05220.creator: Aurelio Amerio, Dan Hooper, and Tim Linden
arxiv-2412-05220.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aurelio Amerio, Dan Hooper, and Tim Linden. We study the gamma-ray emission from millisecond pulsars within the Milky Way’s globular cluster system in order to measure the luminosity function of this source population. We find that these pulsars have a mean luminosity of ⟨ L γ ⟩ ∼ ( 1 − 8 ) × 10 33 ​ erg / s \langle L_{\gamma}\rangle\sim(1-8)\times 10^{33}\,{\rm erg/s} (integrated between 0.1 and 100 GeV) and a log-normal width of σ L ∼ 1.4 − 2.8 \sigma_{L}\sim 1.4-2.8 .

arxiv-2505-04091.title: Study of B → π ​ ρ B\to\pi\rho , π ​ ω \pi\omega decays in the modified perturbative QCD approach
arxiv-2505-04091.creator: Sheng Lü, Mao-Zhi Yang
arxiv-2505-04091.description: Abstract We investigate the B → π ​ ρ B\to\pi\rho and π ​ ω \pi\omega decay processes using the modified perturbative QCD (PQCD) approach. Sudakov factors arising from the resummation of the double logarithms for the contributions of the transverse momenta of partons can increase the applicability of perturbative calculations.

arxiv-2505-22626.title: Scizor : A Self-Supervised Approach to Data Curation for Large-Scale Imitation Learning
arxiv-2505-22626.creator: Yu Zhang, Yuqi Xie, Huihan Liu, Rutav Shah, Michael Wan, Linxi “Jim” Fan, Yuke Zhu
arxiv-2505-22626.description: Abstract Imitation learning advances robot capabilities by enabling the acquisition of diverse behaviors from human demonstrations. However, large-scale datasets used for policy training often introduce substantial variability in quality, which can negatively impact performance. As a result, automatically curating datasets by filtering low-quality samples to improve quality becomes essential.

arxiv-2508-06063.title: Distribution-Specific Learning for Joint Salient and Camouflaged Object Detection
arxiv-2508-06063.creator: Chao Hao, Zitong Yu, Xin Liu, Yuhao Wang, Weicheng Xie, Jingang Shi, Huanjing Yue, Jingyu Yang
arxiv-2508-06063.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chao Hao, Zitong Yu, Xin Liu, Yuhao Wang, Weicheng Xie, Jingang Shi, Huanjing Yue, Jingyu Yang. Salient object detection (SOD) and camouflaged object detection (COD) are two closely related but distinct computer vision tasks. Although both are class-agnostic segmentation tasks that map from RGB space to binary space, the former aims to identify the most salient objects in the image, while the latter focuses on detecting perfectly camouflaged objects that blend into the background in the image. These two tasks exhibit strong contradictory attributes.

arxiv-2511-11735.description: Abstract Many neural networks for point clouds are, by design, invariant to the symmetries of this datatype: permutations and rigid motions. The purpose of this paper is to examine whether such networks preserve natural symmetry aware distances on the point cloud spaces, through the notion of bi-Lipschitz equivalence.

pmc-10692999.description: Biparental sex is widespread in nature, yet costly relative to uniparental reproduction. It is generally unclear why self-fertilizing or asexual lineages do not readily invade outcrossing populations. The Red Queen hypothesis predicts that coevolving parasites can prevent self-fertilizing or asexual lineages from invading outcrossing host populations.

pmc-11726921.title: Absenteeism and Productivity Loss Due to Influenza or Influenza-like Illness in Adults in Europe and North America
pmc-11726921.creator: David Fisman, Maarten Postma, Myron J. Levin, Joaquin Mould-Quevedo
pmc-11726921.description: Healthy working-age adults are susceptible to illness or caregiving requirements resulting from annual seasonal influenza, leading to considerable societal and economic impacts. The objective of this targeted narrative review is to understand the societal burden of influenza in terms of absenteeism and productivity loss, based on the current literature.

pmc-12531182.title: What is the relationship between microorganisms in the human body and upper tract urothelial carcinoma?
pmc-12531182.creator: Xin Pei, Minghui Yu, Yijia Wang, Shi Zong, Fei Qi, Kaichen Wang
pmc-12531182.description: Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma (UTUC) is a highly malignant tumor originating from the epithelium of the upper urinary tract with diverse pathogenesis, but currently available diagnostic and therapeutic strategies have some limitations. In recent years, human microbiome-related studies have provided new ideas for the exploration of the pathogenesis and treatment of UTUC.

pmc-12723873.description: BackgroundCervical cancer remains a major public health challenge in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), mainly due to low screening uptake. pmc-12776031.title: Efficacy of acupuncture for chronic migraine: a protocol for a multicenter randomized controlled trial
pmc-12776031.creator: Qianxiu Chen, Zhe Wang, Yu Tang, Xinyu Wu, Yijie Wang, Tianyu Bai, Ying Gao, Huafeng Cui, Jiamei Zhang, Pengcheng Li, Jing Han
pmc-12776031.description: IntroductionChronic migraine (CM) is a prevalent neurovascular disorder that significantly affects quality of life. Research has shown promising results for the efficacy of acupuncture in the treatment of chronic migraine. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy of acupuncture as a prophylactic treatment for chronic migraine through a multicenter randomized controlled trial.

pmc-13538368.title: Population-scale disease-associated tandem repeat analysis reveals locus and ancestry-specific insights
pmc-13538368.creator: Indhu-Shree Rajan-Babu, Readman Chiu, Ben Weisburd, Iris Caglayan, Inanc Birol, Jan M Friedman
pmc-13538368.description: Tandem repeat (TR) expansions, including short TRs (motifs ≤6 bp) and variable number TRs (motifs >6 bp), underlie many monogenic disorders, with variable length and sequence influencing pathogenicity, penetrance, severity, and onset. Accurate genotype-phenotype correlation and disease prevalence estimation require characterization beyond repeat length.

pmc-13559866.title: Comparative Phytochemical and Biological Evaluation of Four Thymus Species From Türkiye for Dermocosmetic Applications
pmc-13559866.creator: Ebru Özdemir Nath, Pierre‐Eric Campos, Audrey Le Cabec, Gül İpek Gündoğan, Diren Ergin, Ahsen Çetin, Sefa Sönmez, Emilie Destandau
pmc-13559866.description: Species of Thymus have long been used in Anatolia for wound healing and skin disorders. This study characterized metabolites and biological activities of four taxa—Thymus leucostomus (TL), Thymus sipyleus (TS), Thymus brachychilus (TB), and Thymus migricus (TM)—using UHPLC‐HRMS/MS‐based molecular networking, anti‐aging enzyme inhibition assays, and cellular models (L929 fibroblasts, HaCaT keratinocytes, HUVEC endothelial cells).

pmc-13612949.description: ObjectiveThis study examined the mediating role of self-efficacy in the relationship between social integration and self-disgust among patients with stroke, with the aim of informing the development of targeted interventions.MethodsIn this cross-sectional study, a total of 207 patients with stroke completed a general demographic questionnaire, the Stroke Rehabilitation Self-Efficacy Assessment Scale, the Social Network Scale, and a self-disgust assessment tool.

uslaw-usc-t10-s127f.title: 10 U.S.C. § 127f — Expenditure of funds for clandestine activities that support operational preparation of the environment and non-conventional assisted recovery capabilities
uslaw-usc-t10-s127f.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s127f.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization And General Military Powers); Chapter 3 (General Powers And Functions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority.— (1) Amounts appropriated or otherwise made available for the Department of Defense for operation and maintenance, Defense-wide, may be used for any purpose the Secretary of Defense determines to be proper— (A) for operational preparation.

uslaw-usc-t2-s5307.title: 2 U.S.C. § 5307 — Certification of salary and mileage accounts
uslaw-usc-t2-s5307.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s5307.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 53 (House Of Representatives Members); Subchapter I (Member Pay). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Salary and mileage accounts of Representatives and Delegates shall be certified by the Speaker of the House of Representatives; and such certificates shall be conclusive upon all the departments and officers of the Government.
